title: Gazetteer of Upper Burma and the Shan States (Part I Vol I)
author: Sir J. George Scott & J. P. Hardiman
description: The premier master volume of the monumental British colonial gazetteer of Upper Burma and the Shan States. Part I Volume I provides an extensive comparative ethnological, linguistic, and historical survey of the Tai (Shan) family of languages, detailing their northern cradle, historic migration routes into Assam (Ahom, Khamti, Khamyang/Nora, Phake), dialectology, and folklore.
source: Rangoon: Superintendent, Government Printing, Burma, Archive ID: gazetteerupperb06hardgoog
